brewing.notes: A safe starting point for green tea: cooler water, short steeps, then adjust by taste.

description:
A top grade of Fujian jasmine tea, made from a very downy tea variety so that the finished leaf is cloaked in white hairs.

Recipes for a flavoured or scented tea vary from one maker to the next, so read the ingredient list and brew it like its base tea.
history: It belongs to the jasmine tradition of Fuzhou and northeastern Fujian and is regarded as the finest of that province's jasmine teas. Little more is documented about it.
processing: Exceptionally careful work on a downy basket-dried green base, scented with jasmine.
harvest_season: The base tea can come from any picking, so the season matters less than the recipe.
appearance_dry: Plump buds with abundant down, of a tender yellow.
appearance_wet: Usually soft green leaf that opens up in the water.
taste_profile: Fresh, strong and lasting fragrance with a mellow, full taste.
vintage_note: Flavoured and scented teas are not sold by vintage. Buy recent stock and drink it within a year or so, since the aroma fades.
